files.description: Full-page screenshot of the EHI Export Specifications page. Shows the header section with EHI definition, the b(10) compliance bullet points, a large blank area (empty PDF Viewer Pro widget), and the introductory text promising documentation that does not exist.
Screenshot focused on the blank PDF Viewer Pro widget area of the page, showing the empty 1109px-tall section where a PDF document was intended to be embedded but was never uploaded.

Extracted text content from the rendered Wix page. Contains the EHI definition (quoting 45 CFR), b(10) compliance requirement bullet points for single-patient and patient-population exports, and introductory text promising documentation about 'resulting files from the EHI Export' that was never published. No data dictionary, export format specification, or technical content is present.
files.curl_command: curl -sL 'https://www.ezemrx.com/ehi-export' -H 'User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0' (requires browser rendering — raw HTML is Wix SPA JavaScript)

files.description: EHI Export data dictionary PDF (9 pages). Documents export file formats (CSV, C-CDA XML), table/column definitions for demographics, insurance, encounters, vitals, lab results, medications, immunizations, allergies, billing, patient notes, and scanned records. Version 2.0, April 25, 2024.
Plain text extraction of the EHI Export data dictionary PDF via pdftotext.
Enrichment script: extracts structured data dictionary from the PDF into queryable JSON.
Enrichment output: structured file categories, CSV schemas (24 columns across 2 tables), file naming conventions, metadata.
Enrichment documentation: run commands, input boundary, output files, known limitations.
